# R2.9b — egress/containment residual (half B): typed lowering-loss, C2 wire guards, body-reader closer, Stage-3 leak scan, security metrics

Ticket `docs/tickets/115_R2.9__egress-containment-legs.md` (seq 115) —
the second half of the ticket's pre-registered `R2.9a`/`R2.9b` split
(`## Notes`; manifest `## Plan extensions` 2026-10-07). Stacked on
`svitali/harnessharness-r2.9` (#115); ADR-0341. Offline-only: every cell
is `fixture`-verified — no live/staging environment is touched or
claimed; the real TLS-terminating transport stays DF-S2.4-2/BL-31.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.12-4 · DF-S1.12-6 · DF-S2.4-3 · R-2.8.2 ·
R-2.8.3 · R-2.8.4 · BL-18.

## What landed

**DF-S1.12-4 residual — DONE.** `lowering_loss` is the typed
`LoweringLoss{declared_field, backend, reason, kind, consequence}` row
(ADR-0341 D1 — `LossItem` kept as the compatibility alias); every
backend reports its own unsatisfiable declared fields
(`net.tls.terminate`, `net.tls.inspect_hooks`, `net.upstream_proxy`,
`net.proxy_env`, `proc.env`, …) with `consequence ∈ {fail_closed,
stratified}` (D2/D4 — a `stratified` loss demotes the stratification
claim without refusing attach; the pre-R2.9b reason-string sniff is
gone). `security.containment.applied` durably carries
`lowering_loss_fields` (D5 — closed content-free tags; the
`hh-ledger` class table registers the member). The four §5g.4 §6
metrics are pure folds (`hh-eval::security_metrics::fold`) over the
run's durable rows — `egress.ask_rate` (asked/decided ppm),
`containment.violation_rate` (violated/applied ppm),
`proxy.hijack_attempt_rate` (applied rows carrying a proxy-surface
loss-field tag / applied ppm — reads `lowering_loss_fields`, never the
blob), `session.revoked_continuation_denied` (count of
`credential.denied{reason: revoked}`); `hh-experiment::settle` and the
hosted path emit `measurement.metric.emitted{metric_ref, value,
applies_to}` per produced value — `None` stays unemitted
(`n/a{not_run}`, never 0) (D7). Catalogue registers
`proxy.hijack_attempt_rate` + `session.revoked_continuation_denied`
beside the existing two.

**DF-S1.12-6 — DONE.** (a) `tls.terminate`-required + a TLS leg + a
transport that cannot terminate refuses typed
`Refused{tls_terminate_unsupported}` with a durable
`decided{deny, source: tls_guard}` — the wire never fires;
`EgressTransport::terminates_tls()` (default `false`) is the honest
capability seam (D3). (b) `inspect_hooks` — the declared set runs in
declaration order over the sentinel-spelling `InspectView` (a hook can
never read a credential value — D4); an unregistered declared ref
refuses `inspect_hook_unavailable`, a `deny` verdict refuses
`inspect_hook_denied`; `decided` rows carry `guard_detail` +
`tls_terminated`. (c) `approved_host_body` — the reader-set closer
`readers(body) ⊇ recipients(p)` runs in `decide_egress` **and** at the
mediator on every allow including body-blind approval-cache hits
(`deny{reader_coverage, flow_guard}`); `EgressRequest.body_readers` is
plumbed at dispatch from `flow.param_labels["body"]`; `Public` covers
all destinations, `Restricted` covers `host_norm`, `None` is unproven;
an undeclared residual stays a readiness gap, never a verdict (D6).

**DF-S2.4-3 — DONE.** `leak_scan_run`'s domain is the run's whole
durable surface with the one `DetectorSet` (CC1): every committed event
payload, the seq-0 manifest (`ScanTarget::Manifest`), every blob-pool
object (`ScanTarget::Blob`), and each `measurement.export.delivered`
row re-tagged under its `ScanTarget::SinkDelivery` surface — a leak
attributes to the delivery leg that carried it (D8).

**BL-18 → closed.** All `R-2.8.4` members discharged across R2.9a +
R2.9b.

## Tests (fail-if-removed)

- `crates/hh-containment/tests/r2_9b.rs` — 7 cells: typed loss rows on
  every backend, `net.proxy_env` stratified under `mediated`,
  `lowering_loss_fields` durability, the pure `decide_egress` closer
  (covered/uncovered/cache-hit legs), undeclared residual = readiness
  gap.
- `crates/hh-env/tests/r2_9b.rs` — 6 cells: TLS terminate refuse
  (`decided{deny, tls_guard}` + zero wire calls) / terminating
  forwards (`tls_terminated: true`) / plain-leg unaffected; hook
  unregistered refuses, deny refuses, allow forwards;
  `approved_host_body` closer at the mediator.
- `crates/hh-secrets/tests/r2_9b.rs` — 4 cells: blob-pool, manifest
  and sink-delivery leak attribution; clean run scans ∅.
- `crates/hh-eval/src/security_metrics.rs` — 5 unit cells over the
  fold (rates, count, `None`-never-0).
- `crates/hh-experiment/tests/engine.rs` — `settle_emits_the_security_
  metric_folds` (ppm/count values + `applies_to`) +
  `settle_emits_nothing_when_security_never_ran` (the `n/a` half).
